svg.title: BugSigDB automated curation: end-to-end workflow
svg.desc: Gold-building commands feed only the scorer. The curator takes a PMID, runs stages S0 to S9 (with optional supplement and verifier stages), and emits a prediction record that the scorer and human review packets consume. A data firewall separates the curator from the gold.
svg.text: A · INGEST — build the held-out gold
B · CURATE — sees a PMID only (never any gold field)
Hungarian experiment match; taxa as NCBI
taxid sets → P / R / F1 by gold source type
one HTML per draft, zipped for curators
who judge it against the paper → verdict JSON
Prediction records cross the firewall one way:
curator → scorer. Gold never flows the other way.
Names → taxids via TaxonomyDB; retired ids
canonicalised through merged.dmp on both sides.
data firewall: curator never reads gold
